mapper.sql: select a.id, a.code, a.advance_registration_id, a.material_id, a.material_name, a.material_code, a.rfid, a.batch_code, a.tray_id, a.location_id, a.status, a.use_count, a.weight, a.price, a.small_unit_count, a.detection_fail_type, a.detection_fail_remark, a.detection_fail_status, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.dept_id, a.dept_name, a.del_flag from t_material_detail a
mapper.delete: update t_material_detail set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update t_material_detail set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}

update t_material_detail set del_flag = '1' where advance_registration_id in
#{deliveryDetail}
mapper.select:
select a.batch_code as batchcode, tm.name as materialName , tm.code as materialCode, tu.name as unitName, tm.unit_price , count( 1 ) as currentcount, sum( a.weight ) as totalweight, sum( a.price ) as totalprice, min(a.create_time) createTime from t_material_detail a left join t_material tm on a.material_id = tm.id left join t_unit tu on tm.unit_id = tu.id
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = a.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
a.del_flag = 0 and a.material_code like concat('%', #{entity.materialcode}, '%') and a.material_name like concat('%', #{entity.materialname}, '%') and a.batch_code like concat('%', #{entity.batchcode}, '%') and date_format(a.create_time,'%y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{entity.startDate},'%y-%m-%d') and date_format(a.create_time,'%y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{entity.endDate},'%y-%m-%d')
${entity.params.dataScope} group by batchcode,a.material_id

select cu.name contactsUnitName, cu.contact_person contactsUnitContact, count(case when md.detection_fail_status in (1,2) then 1 else null end) detectionCount, count(case when md.detection_fail_status =1 then 1 else null end) detectionPassCount from t_contacts_unit cu left join t_material m on cu.id=m.contacts_unit_id and m.del_flag=0 left join t_material_detail md on m.id=md.material_id and md.detection_fail_status in (1,2) where cu.del_flag=0
and cu.name like concat('%',#{contactsUnitName},'%')
and cu.contact_person like concat('%',#{contactsUnitContact},'%')
group by cu.id order by cu.id desc

SELECT a.id, a.CODE, a.advance_registration_id, a.material_id, a.material_name, a.material_code, a.rfid, a.batch_code, a.weight, a.price,a.rfid_head, tu.NAME AS unitName, m.description,m.specifications, DATE_FORMAT(b.produced_date,'%Y-%m-%d') as produced_date FROM t_material_detail a LEFT JOIN t_material m ON a.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN t_unit tu ON m.unit_id = tu.id LEFT JOIN t_advance_delivery_detail b ON a.advance_registration_id = b.id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.CODE, a.advance_registration_id, a.material_id, a.material_name, a.material_code, a.rfid, a.batch_code, a.weight, a.price, tu.NAME AS unitName, m.description,m.specifications, DATE_FORMAT(b.produced_date,'%Y-%m-%d') as produced_date FROM t_material_detail a LEFT JOIN t_material m ON a.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN t_unit tu ON m.unit_id = tu.id LEFT JOIN t_advance_delivery_detail b ON a.advance_registration_id = b.id LEFT JOIN t_advance_delivery c on b.advance_delivery_id = c.id WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.`status` = '0' AND c.id = #{advanceId}

SELECT a.id, a.CODE, a.advance_registration_id, a.material_id, a.material_name, a.material_code, a.rfid, a.batch_code, a.detection_fail_status, tu.NAME AS unitName, m.description,m.specifications FROM t_material_detail a LEFT JOIN t_material m ON a.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN t_unit tu ON m.unit_id = tu.id WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.`status` = '0' and (a.rfid_head is null or a.rfid_head = '') AND a.advance_registration_id = #{deliveryDetailId}

SELECT t_advance_delivery.`code` AS 'ruku_code',t_advance_delivery_detail.id AS 'rukuzi_code', t_material.`code` AS 'wuliao_code',t_material.`name` ,t_advance_delivery_detail.batch_code ,t_advance_delivery_detail.predict_count, (SELECT SUM(rfid_count) FROM t_material_detail WHERE advance_registration_id = t_advance_delivery_detail.id AND ruku_saomiao = 1) AS 'saomiao_shuliang', (SELECT MAX(ruku_saomiao_time) FROM t_material_detail WHERE advance_registration_id = t_advance_delivery_detail.id AND ruku_saomiao = 1) AS 'saomiao_shijian' From t_advance_delivery_detail LEFT JOIN t_advance_delivery ON t_advance_delivery_detail.advance_delivery_id = t_advance_delivery.id LEFT JOIN t_material ON t_advance_delivery_detail.material_id = t_material.id WHERE t_advance_delivery_detail.del_flag = 0 and t_advance_delivery.`code` =#{sdto.rukuCode} and t_material.`code`=#{sdto.wuliaoCode} and date_format((SELECT MAX(ruku_saomiao_time) FROM t_material_detail WHERE advance_registration_id = t_advance_delivery_detail.id AND ruku_saomiao = 1),'%y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{sdto.saomiaoShijianStart},'%y-%m-%d') and date_format((SELECT MAX(ruku_saomiao_time) FROM t_material_detail WHERE advance_registration_id = t_advance_delivery_detail.id AND ruku_saomiao = 1),'%y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{sdto.saomiaoShijianEnd},'%y-%m-%d') ORDER BY t_advance_delivery.code DESC

SELECT tmd.material_code AS 'wuliao_code' , tmd.material_name AS 'name', tmd.batch_code , tmd.rfid , tmd.rfid_count , tmd.ruku_saomiao AS 'rfid_Flag', tmd.ruku_saomiao_time AS 'saomiao_shijian' FROM t_material_detail tmd WHERE tmd.advance_registration_id = #{sdtoZi.rukuCode}
